Summarise an association scan

Source: R/gwas-methods.R
summary.indri_gwas.Rd

The SNPs with the smallest p-values and the genomic inflation factor lambda_gc (the median test statistic over its expectation under the null; near 1 for a calibrated scan of mostly null SNPs).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'indri_gwas'
summary(object, n = 10L, ...)

Arguments

object

An indri_gwas scan.

n

Number of top SNPs (or SNP-trait pairs) to list.

...

Unused.

Value

An object of class summary.indri_gwas with top (a data frame), lambda_gc (one value, or one per trait for single-trait scans), n_tested and the scan's description.
